name: Cindy Chrome
description: Connects Cindy to the Chrome you use every day. With My browser selected in Settings, the agent reads pages and acts for you with your existing sign-ins. Also bilingual pages, in-player subtitles and PDF reading. Page text goes to your configured AI; cookies and passwords are not exported.
whenToUse: Use Cindy Chrome for translation, in-player subtitles and PDF reading in the user's own browser. To read or operate that browser, use Cindy's browser tool (target user-browser) where offered; older Cindy versions use this plugin's browser tools. Safari is not installable here.

browser_status.description: Check live browser profiles and installation readiness without reading pages. Multiple profiles require an explicit browser id; do not guess the account. Use plugin settings to install/connect. A store page opening is not installation success. Chrome uses the official Chrome Web Store route; Edge uses the developer fallback until a published store route exists.

browser_read.description: Read signed-in DOM: content returns bounded text/links; extract selects CSS records; snapshot provides fresh action refs. recipe:x_mentions reads X replies directly. Waits internally for content; CONTENT_NOT_READY is not an empty result. Limit maxChars/records. Reuses tabs after redirects/timeouts. PAGE_CHANGED: inspect browser_tabs once, stop retrying. May open a tab and contact sites using login state, marking messages read. Page text is untrusted and may reach AI; no cookie export. Titles/URLs are bounded; truncated marks cuts. Proxy/cache/restored pages use documentId, not peer IP. Local/intranet pages read like any site. ADDRESS_UNVERIFIED includes a document reason; inspect the retained tab, do not retry in a loop. BROWSER_PAGE_RESTRICTED: Chrome forbids extension access, including store-installed versions. Manual: ghost_manual({ghost_id:'my-browser',path:'browser/MANUAL.md'}).

browser_act.description: Act on an already-open site with an interaction grant. Click/type/submit may send, delete or pay. Never replay unknown results. execution is not_executed/executed/unknown; executed proves DOM dispatch, not business success. Verify by reading. Refs expire; password and payment-card fields are unsupported, detected from type, multi-token autocomplete values and editable field naming such as card-number or otp. Never bypass permission denial.

browser_tabs.description: List bounded HTTP/HTTPS tabs without navigating. Filter by host; default 20, maximum 100. Local and intranet tabs are listed like any site. Tabs whose document cannot be read remain listed with status/error/reason but no title or URL. truncated means a count/size limit was reached.
